QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_9

question.text: Set-up costs are typically amortized over:

answer.text: First 36 months, or the entire fund life, commencing from date of First Close

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 6.1.1, set-up costs amortize over first 36 months or over the entire fund life, commencing from First Close. The Trap: Shorter periods front-load costs; 10-year horizon is only for longer-tenure funds.
